dataset.name: Japanese primary liver cancer (ICGC LIRI-JP)
dataset.description: Independent Japanese liver-cancer cohort with open ICGC Release 28 bulk RNA-seq expression and linked overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: Predominantly primary hepatocellular carcinoma from Japanese patients, many with hepatitis B or C infection. The cohort is retained as a distinct external context rather than pooled with TCGA-LIHC.

metadata.redistribution_note: The open cohort is analyzable in TCGA-TRACE, while direct matrix download remains disabled pending a dedicated ICGC redistribution review.
metadata.curation_note: TCGA-TRACE uses only endpoint-complete donors with an open RefSeq/FKPM RNA-seq analysis linked to a primary solid-tumor specimen. One analysis is selected deterministically per donor.

expression.label: log2(FPKM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: ICGC Release 28 exp_seq RefSeq gene_id field
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: The adapter requires one unique gene symbol per selected analysis and retains only genes complete across all selected donors.
expression.scale_note: ICGC labels the normalized_read_count algorithm as FKPM; this is treated as the source FPKM scale and transformed once as log2(value + 1).
